| 整理大量资料后关窗口 | 资料丢了 | 自动归档，随时检索找回 |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"> 但 dsh-mneme 的可信之处，恰恰在你**看不见**的后台。下面这些，才是它和「一个会存东西的插件」的本质区别。"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## 为什么可以信任它"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- 🧾 **可回放、可追责** — 每次自动整理都留一张「决策凭证」：输入快照 + 决策明细 + 结果哈希，同样的整理可复现回放，**不默默吞错、不留无法追溯的改动**。

You mentioned wanting to use Astro." |
| Tell the AI you"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"r coding habits | Repeat every session | Set once, remember forever |
| Close window after organizin"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"g research | Notes are lost | Auto-archived, retrievable anytime |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"> But what makes dsh-mneme trustworthy lives in the background you never see. These are the traits t"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"hat set it apart from "a plugin that just saves things.""},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Why you can trust it"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- 🧾 **Replayable, accountable** — every consolidation leaves a "decision receipt": input snapshot + "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"decision detail + result hash. The same run reproduces the same outcome. **No silent mis-merges, no "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"untraceable changes.**
- ⚖️ **Conflicts freeze, you decide** (opt-in) — when two memories contradict"},{"id":"p27s4","text":", it does not take sides for you. The suspected conflict is **parked for review**, compared side-by-"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"side in the status-page conflict queue, and resolved with one click (keep A / keep B / mark reviewed"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"). On hard judgments, a human stays in the loop.
- 🔐 **Memories isolated by agent & workspace** (opt"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"-in) — with `scopeEnabled`, every memory is stamped with which agent wrote it and in which workspace"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"; retrieval favors the current scope (weighted hits, out-of-scope demoted but visible); `strictScope"},{"id":"p27s9","text":"` goes further — memories **explicitly** scoped to other agents/workspaces become invisible to searc"},{"id":"p27s10","text":"h and injection (auto carrier labels are demoted only, never hard-blocked). Multiple agents and proj"},{"id":"p27s11","text":"ects, zero cross-talk.
- 🌙 **It works while you sleep** (opt-in) — idle time triggers tiered archivi"},{"id":"p27s12","text":"ng: frequent memories stay hot, stale ones compress to summaries, old ones archive. The store **stay"},{"id":"p27s13","text":"s lean as it grows**.
- 🧠 **Semantic search that can run fully offline** — set `embedProvider` to `l"},{"id":"p27s14","text":"ocal` and retrieval uses local embedding + reranking, no API key needed; without an embedder, keywor"},{"id":"p27s15","text":"d / BM25 retrieval still works.
- 📝 **Two-way Markdown sync** — memories are local `.md` files you c"},{"id":"p27s16","text":"an open and edit; **human edits are respected**, never clobbered by the machine.
- 💾 **Delete the se"},{"id":"p27s17","text":"ssion ≠ delete the memory** — memories are cross-session global knowledge; clearing a chat window ke"},{"id":"p27s18","text":"eps what was saved (unbound from sessions since v0.7.11)."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"> **How does it compare with Zep / Mem0 / Letta / Hindsight?** There is a row-by-row table — storage"},{"id":"p28s2","text":", retrieval, write-time extraction, offline consolidation, conflicts, forgetting, scoping, auditabil"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ity, multi-host, offline, license: 11 rows, and **"—" does not mean "worse"**: capability comparison"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"host, offline, license: 11 rows, and **"—" does not mean "worse"**: capability comparison (Chinese)."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Privacy"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- Memories stay on your machine: a local SQLite store plus editable Markdown mirrors, with no mneme "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"server in the path
- Memories are Markdown files, human-readable and editable
- No mneme API key req"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"uired; consolidation and summarization use the host model you already configured (`autoDream` / `aut"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"oSummarize` are on by default)
- Want consolidation fully offline too? Point the host at a local mod"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"el **and** clear `dreamProvider` / `dreamModel` plus `summarizeProvider` / `summarizeModel` (setting"},{"id":"p30s6","text":" those routes talks straight to that provider, so switching the host alone will not help) — or just "},{"id":"p30s7","text":"turn off `autoDream` / `autoSummarize`
